papers_read.title: MoleculeNet: A Benchmark for Molecular Machine Learning
papers_read.relevance: Defines the benchmark datasets (BACE, BBBP, ClinTox, HIV, MUV), evaluation metrics (ROC-AUC, PRC-AUC), and splitting strategies (scaffold, random)
key_extractions: Learnable representations broadly offer best performance
Struggle with data scarcity and class imbalance

papers_read.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN)
papers_read.relevance: Defines the GCN layer used as the message-passing backbone in both baseline and KA-GNN
key_extractions: GCN propagation rule: H^(l+1) = σ(D^(-1/2) A D^(-1/2) H^(l) W^(l))
First-order approximation of spectral graph convolutions
Linear scaling in number of edges

papers_read.title: Graph Attention Networks (GAT)
papers_read.relevance: Alternative GNN architecture using attention mechanisms; provides context for GNN design choices
key_extractions: Attention-based message passing as alternative to GCN
Applicable to both transductive and inductive settings

papers_read.title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (CGCNN)
papers_read.relevance: Demonstrates graph-based neural networks for property prediction with interpretability via local chemical environment analysis
key_extractions: Interpretability through contribution analysis from local environments
